rationale: The agent identified the user via name and ZIP, but then performed order-changing actions (cancelling orders and initiating a return) without explicitly confirming each action with the user, violating the confirm-before-write requirement. The agent also failed to provide the requested tracking number or address the user’s question about refunding or reordering the lost tablet, nor did it offer an appropriate handoff if it couldn’t handle that request. Additionally, the agent acted on multiple items at once despite the user’s preference to do one thing at a time. The final message only mentions the sneaker return and omits other actions and details, providing incomplete final information. Therefore, it does not meet the pass bar.
